rules.name: Abeyant
rules.description: A model equipped with an Abeyant gains +2” to their Movement (M) Chrematistic. In addition, they gain +1 to their Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) Characteristic. A model equipped with an Abeyant cannot embark on a Transport and is considered to have the Bulky (4) special rule. The equipped model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule.

rules.name: Arch Magos
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Battle-Hardened special rule and improves its Battle Smith (x) special rule by 1. In addition, improve the units Ballistic Skill (BS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics by 1.

rules.name: Ordo Cybernetica
rules.description: This unit may join units with the Automata type. Attached Automata type units ignore the restrictions on targeting for Shooting and Charging while the unit with this upgrade is attached. In addition, the attached Automata unit uses this units Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristics.

rules.name: Ordo Magi
rules.description: A model with this upgrade always counts as controlling an Objective it is on, regardless of the number of enemy models attempting to contest the objective

rules.name: Ordo Genetor
rules.description: In the Shooting Phase, instead of Shooting, a unit with this upgrade may select 1 Infantry type unit it is attached to. That unit Heals D3 Wounds or regains D3 slain models.

rules.name: Ordo Logi
rules.description: This unit gains the Linked special rule on all Shooting Weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Ordo Reductor
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit gain the Tank Hunter and Siege Attacker special rules.

rules.name: Techno-Augur
rules.description: This unit always counts as controlling an Objective, regardless of the number of the enemy models contesting the objective.

rules.name: Cybernetica Control Node
rules.description: A model with this wargear may join Automata type units even though it is not Automata type. Any Automata type unit that this model joins ignores the restrictions on Shooting and Charging the closest enemy unit. Attached Automata type units may use this models Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic if it is higher than their own.

rules.name: Nosphere Control Node
rules.description: A Combat Servitor unit attached to this unit may use this units Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic instead of their own.

rules.name: Doctrina Imperative
rules.description:
At the start of each of your Movement Phases, you may select 1 friendly Skitarii unit within 12” to gain 1 of the following effects:
• Conqueror Imperative: The selected Skitarii unit gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.
• Protector Imperative: The selected Skitarii unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic.

rules.name: Secutarii Axiarch
rules.description: A model with this upgrade increases their Armor Save (SV) to a 3+. It exchanges its Power Sword, Control Stave and Archeotech Pistol for Arc Maul and Radium Pistol. In addition, the model may re-roll save rolls of 1.

rules.name: Prime Reductor
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all friendly Mechanicus units in your army gain the Tank Hunter and Siege Attacker special rules.

rules.name: Rad Phage
rules.description: All units within 3” of this unit in the Combat Phase suffer -1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic. This does not stack with other instances of the Rad Phage special rule.

rules.name: Repulsor Grid
rules.description: All attacks which target this unit in the Shooting Phase or as part of an Overwatch Attack are always resolved as the attacking models weapons have the Gets Hot! Special rule.

rules.name: Galvanic Traction Drive
rules.description: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save against all hits against its Side and Rear Armour. This unit gains Move Through Cover.

rules.name: Rotor Jets
rules.description: A model with this wargear increases its wearer's Movement (M) Characteristic to 12” and gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly, and Deep Strike Special rule.

rules.name: Emanatus Force Field
rules.description: This confers a 6+ Invulnerable save. If another Onager Dune Crawler unit is within 12”, this increases to a 5+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Binaric Command
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule may only be your Warlord if your army does not include Tech-Priest Dominus unit.

sharedRules.name: Binaric Domination
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule would fail a Panic test, instead of falling back, the unit is Pinned instead.

sharedRules.name: Cult of the Machine God
sharedRules.description: All Mars units in your army gain the Zealot special rule.

sharedRules.name: Beset on all sides
sharedRules.description: Your army must include at least 1 Combat Servitor or Kataphron Battle Servitor unit per 1,000pts.

sharedRules.name: Lucius Pattern Solar Armour
sharedRules.description: Lucius units in your army gain a 6+ Invulnerable save. If they already have an Invulnerable save, this is increased by 1 to a max of 4+.

sharedRules.name: Agripinaa Pattern Auto Weapons
sharedRules.description: Agripinna units equipped with Auto Weapons gain +6” to their range. For the purposes of this special rule, an Auto Weapon is any weapon listed under the ‘Auto’ category.

sharedRules.name: Presumed Victory Calculations
sharedRules.description: Graia units may not perform Retreat Moves in the Movement phase unless they are within 6” of a Tech-Priest unit.

sharedRules.name: Graia Pattern Cerebral Implants
sharedRules.description: Graia Skitarii units gain the Binaric Domination special rule.

sharedRules.name: Stygies VIII Pattern Stealth Projectors
sharedRules.description: Stygies units in your army always gain the benefit of Light Cover. If the unit is already benefiting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover.

sharedRules.name: Canticles of the Omnissiah
sharedRules.description:
At the start of each Movement Phase, this unit may make a Leadership test. On a pass, you may select 1 of the following Canticles to be in effect. The selected Canticle affects all friendly Adeptus Mechanicum units on the Battlefield. On a fail, nothing happens. The selected Canticle remains in effect until a unit with this special rule makes another Leadership Test where on a pass, they may change the Canticle in effect:
• Litany of the Electromancer: All Adeptus Mechanicus units in your army gain the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule. If they already have the Hammer of Wrath (x) special rule, increase the value of X by 1.
• Shroud Psalm: All Adeptus Mechanicus units in your army gain the benefit of Light Cover. If they are already benefiting from Light Cover, they gain the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.
• Chant of the Remorseless Fist: All Adeptus Mechanicus units in your army gain the Furious Charge special rule.
• Incantation of the iron Soul: All Adeptus Mechanicus units in your army gain the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule.
• Vengeance of the Machine Spirit: All Adeptus Mechanicus units in your army gain the Last Stand special rule.

sharedRules.name: Djinn-Sight
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule ignores Light Cover in the Shooting Phase.

sharedRules.name: Galvanic Traction Drive
sharedRules.description: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save against all hits against its Side and Rear Armour. This unit gains Move Through Cover.

rules.name: Blessed Autosimulacra
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Regeneration Special rule. In addition, each time the unit suffers a wound or Penetrating hit, it can roll a D6. On a 5+ that wound or Penetrating hit is ignored.

rules.name: Enhanced Bionics
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule.

rules.name: Automedicae Bionics
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Regeneration special rule.

rules.name: Cyber familiar
rules.description: The equipped model gains +1 to any Invulnerable saves it has (to a max of 3+). In addition, the equipped model may re-roll 1 of the dice when performing the Leadership test for a Machine Rite.

rules.name: Mechadentrites
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear adds +D6 to its Attacks (A) characteristic in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Data Tether
rules.description: A unit which includes a model equipped with this wargear may re-roll Panic tests.

rules.name: Broad Spectrum Data Tether
rules.description: A unit with this wargear and all friendly Adeptus Mechanicus units within 12” may re-roll Panic tests.

rules.name: Omnispex
rules.description: A unit with a model equipped with this wargear gains Ignores Cover all weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Data Spike
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear makes 1 additional, Strength User Attack at initiative Step 1 of the Combat Phase resolved as if it had the Haywire (2+) special rule.

rules.name: Skitarii Warplate
rules.description: This Heavy Warplate is used by the Skitarii and is quite effective at protecting the organic core of its wearer. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Light Battlehide
rules.description: Some smaller Automata designed to move fast have thinner battlehides with less plating. This confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Heavy Battlehide
rules.description: The armoured battlehide of Automata is thick and powerful, able to withstand great force. It confers a 2+ Armour save.

rules.name: Kataphron Demi-Plate
rules.description: A lighter armour plating for Kataphrons using heavy weapons that provides some protection for the long ranged support servitors. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Kataphron Breacher Plate
rules.description: This heavy Fitted armour is used for Kataphrons dedicated to shock assaults where they are intended to soak heavy fire. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Lorica Thallax
rules.description: A Powered armour for those who become Thallax, its near wholly machine body and limited biological organs means it is able to shrug heavy amounts of firepower. It confers a 3+ Armour save. It includes a Jump Pack. A model with this wargear gains +1 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristics. The equipped model gains the Bulky (2) and Relentless special rules.

rules.name: Serberys Mount
rules.description: A model that is equipped with a Serberys mount becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, the equipped model gains +1 to its Toughness (T) characteristic.

rules.name: Programmed for War
rules.description: A model with this trait and any attached unity gains the Preferred Enemy (x) special rules, selecting X during deployment.

rules.name: Necromechanic
rules.description:
A Warlord with this Warlord trait may perform the Rite of Repair
(see Machine Rites) any number of times in your Shooting Phase instead of only once.

rules.name: Machine Savant
rules.description:
A unit with this Warlord trait gains the Battle Smith (1) special rule. If
they already have the Battle Smith (x) special rule, improve the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: Paragon of Metal
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS), Weapon Skill (WS) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, the upgraded unit ignores the normal targeting restrictions on Shooting and Charging for Automata type units.

rules.name: Kyropatris Field Generator
rules.description: A unit with 5 or more models with this Wargear may re-roll failed Armor Saves of 1. In addition, a unit with 10 or more models with this Wargear reduce the strength of shooting attacks made against them by -1 (to a minimum of Strength 1)

sharedSelectionEntries.name: Arc Lance and Mag Inverter Shield

rules.name: Mag Inverter Shield
rules.description: Confers a 5+ Invulnerable Save. A unit with this wargear can never claim +1 Attacks for holding two weapons.

rules.name: Voltaghiest Field
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 5+ Invulnerable save. A model with this special rule gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule. The first time this unit would win Combat in the Combat Phase when calculating Combat Resolution, this unit’s Invulnerable save increases to 4+ for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Shock Charger
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear treats its equipped Close Combat Weapon as being AP3 instead of AP-.

rules.name: Incense Dispenser
rules.description: A model with this wargear always receives the benefit of Light Cover. If this unit is already receiving the benefits of Light Cover, they gain Heavy Cover. If a model with this wargear is already receiving Heaving Cover, it gains a 4+ Cover save.

rules.name: The Purgation’s Purity
rules.description: may exchange its Radium Pistol, Phosphor Serpenta or Archeotech Pistol

rules.name: Raiment of the Techno Martyr
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic and any attached unit may always set to Overwatch even if it made a Shooting attack in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Phospheonix
rules.description: may exchange its Phosphor Serpenta, Radium Serpenta or Arecheotech Pistol for this relic

rules.name: Pater Radium
rules.description: At Initiative Step 1 of a Combat, all enemy units within 3” of a model with this relic take D3 Automatic Wounds with no saves allowed.

rules.name: Pater Radium
rules.description: may exchange its Taser Goad for this relic

rules.name: The Skull of Elder Nikola
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this Relic in the Shooting Phase can declare they will activate the skull. All enemy units within 18” of the model equipped with the Relic take D6, Strength 6, AP3, Haywire (2+), Automatic hits.

rules.name: The Omniscient Mask
rules.description: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gain the Zealot special rule.

rules.name: Anzion’s Psuedogenetor
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains +1D6 to its Attacks (A) characteristic.

rules.name: Autocaduceus of Arkhan Land
rules.description: A model with this Relic automatically succeeds when attempting to perform the Rite of Repair Machine Rite.

rules.name: Mask of the Alpha Dominus
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this Relic may select a friendly Cybernetica unit within 12” in the Shooting Phase or Combat Phase. Until the end of the Phase, the target unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic if it’s the Shooting Phase or +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic if it’s the Combat Phase. This effect lasts until the end of the current Phase.

rules.name: The Scryskull Perspicatus
rules.description: A model with this Relic and any attached unit may re-roll Penetration rolls.

rules.name: The Uncreator Gauntlet
rules.description: When a model equipped with this Relic would fight at its Initiative Step in the Combat Phase, it can select a single enemy Vehicle, Knight, Titan or Aircraft unit within 3”. Immediately roll on the Vehicle Damage table for that target with +2 to the roll instead of conducting the equipped models’ normal attacks.

rules.name: Momento-Mortispex
rules.description: At the start of each of your turns, a model with this Relic and any attached unit can gain one of the following special rules until the start of your next turn: Monster Hunter, Tank Hunter or Skyfire on all equipped Shooting weapons.

rules.name: Numinasta’s Casket of Electromancy
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains the Hammer of Wrath (3) special rule. In addition, this models Hammer of Wrath Attacks are resolved as if they had the Haywire (4+) special rule.

rules.name: Omnissiah’s Grace
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains a 3+ Invulnerable Save.

rules.name: Quantum Annihilator
rules.description: may exchange its Eradication Ray for this relic

rules.name: Sacrifactum Autorepulsor
rules.description: All Charge Rolls against a model equipped with this Relic and any attached unit are resolved at -2. In addition, all charges against a unit equipped with this Relic are resolved as Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Saint Curia’s Autopurger
rules.description: At the end of each Combat Phase, all enemy units within 12” of a model with this Relic take 2D6, Strength 1, AP-, Poison (4+) automatic hits.

rules.name: Pater Cog-Tooth
rules.description: may exchange its Omnissian Axe

rules.name: Rite of Destruction
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 enemy Vehicle, Walker, Knight, Titan or Aircraft unit within 12”. The target unit takes D6, Strength 1, AP- automatic hits. These hits are resolved with the Haywire (4+) special rule. Only Invulnerable saves may be made against these attacks.

rules.name: Rite of Locomotion
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select a Vehicle, Automata, Walker or Aircraft unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit they embarked upon may immediately make a Normal Move. However, the selected unit may not Shoot in the Shooting Phase or Charge in the Charge Phase.
